limitations: All 30 feature snapshots and one allele preserved; incomplete source components are explicit.

patient_identity.statement: C25 is identified as a NIPBL-positive patient in the figure caption, but the female sex and age ten assertions require the unavailable individual clinical supplement.
limitations: Main table is aggregate rather than a patient-level table.

genotype.statement: The main text reports c.6880C>T/p.Q2294X among NIPBL variants but does not tie that variant to C25; Supplementary Table I is necessary for that mapping.
limitations: Do not infer a patient-specific allele from a cohort list.

segregation.statement: Authors state the NIPBL mutations were apparently de novo and absent from respective parents/100 control alleles.
limitations: This is cohort-level support; exact C25-to-variant mapping is unavailable and parentage confirmation is not described.

phase.statement: Packet has one heterozygous variant, so a two-allele cis/trans question is inapplicable; patient-level zygosity is not independently confirmed from the available components.
limitations: No direct phase measurement claimed.

causal_confidence.statement: C25 is NIPBL mutation positive in the caption; authors associate truncating NIPBL variants with a more severe CdLS phenotype.
limitations: Exact mutation/phenotype mapping needs Supplementary Table I; predicted haploinsufficiency is not a measured patient protein effect.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Individual clinical data are expressly assigned to Supplementary Table I. The aggregate Table I cannot establish C25 positives or negatives.
limitations: Unavailable supplement prevents complete patient-level phenotype correspondence. No facial diagnosis or disease-specific negatives are inferred from a photograph.

assessment.statement: c.6880C>T/p.Q2294X exists in the cohort; its mapping to C25, heterozygosity and packet NM_133433.4/GRCh38 coordinates cannot be independently settled from the main manuscript.
limitations: Patient-level Supplementary Table I unavailable; exact transcript version/assembly mapping not verified.

assessment.statement: The packet asserts postnatal growth retardation for C25. The available main text supplies aggregate clinical frequencies and photographs, not a C25-specific statement establishing this item.
limitations: Individual clinical Supplementary Table I is unavailable; absence of mention is not a measured negative and a photo is not a substitute for a clinical examination.
